overview: A redstone block two pixels tall that puts out a full signal while a player stands on it. Players only, never mobs, never spectators.

2.0.1: An icon of its own rather than a borrowed one, and the readme rides along inside the jar.
2.0.0: The detector recipe has an advancement.
The client is told what it is made of.
1.0.2: The signal lets go reliably, even where the chunk dropped the tick meant to switch it off.
A display name fit for a mod list.
1.0.0: A flat, waterloggable redstone block that reads players standing on it and nothing else.
Breaks fastest with a pickaxe, and drops itself by hand.
